entries.speaker: Enthusiastic Female Student
entries.en: I'm going on a trip next week. My mom[n]reserved a hotel!

entries.en: Is this really the right time for that?[n]What are you going to do about your[n]college exams?

entries.speaker: Strict Teacher
entries.en: Wh-What are you saying!? You've[n]worked so hard up until now.

entries.speaker: Strict Teacher

entries.en: When I graduate, I'm going to work at[n]my dad's company. I've been saying that[n]since last year...

entries.en: Meh, it doesn't really matter to me.[n]Actually, I'd be glad if they did.

entries.speaker: Male Student in a Jersey
entries.en: I prefer to just sit on the bench and[n]cheer everyone else on. It's easy,[n]and I can chat with the manager.

entries.speaker: Plump Male Student
